business_summary: Liuzhou Iron&Steel Co., Ltd produces and sells iron and steel products. It offers carbon steel plate; profiles; plates; billets; chemical products; gas; low alloy steel plate; steel plates without trimming; steel plates for molds; ship plates; boiler and pressure vessel plates; bridge plates; steel plate; pipeline steel; automotive girder plate; high-rise buildings; steel plates for automobiles; steel wire rod; cold rolled steel; galvanized steel; hot rolled steel strip; pickled plates , medium and thick plates, ribbed steel bars, high-speed wire rods, medium-sized steel and other products. The company is also involved in ferrous metal smelting and rolling processing industry, and steel rolling, mechanical processing and repair, cement manufacturing, mining, oxygen production, automobile cargo transportation. In addition, its products are used in automobiles, home appliances, petrochemicals, machinery manufacturing, energy transportation, ships, bridges, construction, metal products, nuclear power, electronic instruments, medical equipment, kitchenware and bathroom, construction and decoration. The company was founded in 1958 and is based in Liuzhou, China. Liuzhou Iron&Steel Co., Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Guangxi Liuzhou Iron and Steel Group Co., Ltd.
